description_html:
The VOOPOO PnP-TW Mesh Coil is a replacement coil for compatible VOOPOO devices.

  • Product Type: Replacement Coil
  • Coil Resistance: TW20 0.2Ω / TW30 0.3Ω
  • Coil Material: Mesh
  • Compatible Devices: VOOPOO Drag S / Drag S Pro, Drag X / Drag X Pro, Argus XT / MT / Pro 2, PnP Pod II / PnP-X Pod / PnP Pod Tank
  • Pack Quantity: 5 Coils
  • Brand: VOOPOO

CRC (child-resistant) version.

Coils are consumable - replace when flavour or vapour output drops.

Available options: TW20 Mesh 0.2ohm, TW30 Mesh 0.3ohm.
